integrity: Complete conditional law and asymptotic tails follow from a pointwise trigonometric factorization and elementary product-density analysis; standalone deterministic/numerical verification supplements analytical proof, not an external certification.
limitations: Only uniformly and independently sampled unit-circle boundary endpoints and the crossing segment-pair law; tails are fixed-angle, not uniform at t=0; conditional radial law is an integral and historical priority remains provisional. The marginal angle law, Dirichlet splitting, and unconditional radial marginal are previous results.
title: The angle-conditioned radial law of two crossing random circle chords
